Title: Anil's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Anil - 36 years, son
Look: moustache, checked shirt
2. Sonali - 61 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Meenakshi - 36 years, friend
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun

Places

1. The road - a paved road, trees along it
2. The gym - dumbbells, a treadmill, mirrors

Scene 1: The road - Day

[Anil stands by the road. Sonali and Meenakshi stand near him.]

Sonali: "What lovely weather!"

[Anil drives the car to the office.]

Sonali: "Yes, all right."

[Anil gets out of the car.]

Anil: "Really?"

[Anil rides the scooter with Mother sitting behind him.]

Sonali: "Okay, Anil."

[Anil takes Mother to the market on his motorbike, she sits behind him.]

Anil (surprised): "Show me too!"

[The thug's knife wounds Anil in the stomach; he doubles over.]

Anil (excited): "How beautiful!"

[Anil wades through the knee-deep water.]

Anil: "I knew it!"

Scene 2: The gym - Day

[Anil stands in the gym. Sonali stands near him.]

Anil: "What a nice place."

[Anil lifts weights and grunts.]

Sonali: "Yes, all right."

[Anil does push-ups on the mat.]

Anil: "And then?"

[Anil wipes the sweat off his forehead.]

Anil: "I really enjoyed today."
